text:
lena_sales: Passing Skyline Energy to CS after SOW signed today. Big items: private (VPC) deployment in us-east-1, Okta SAML SSO, and a one-off data ingestion connector to their billing DB. Also asked for a pre-GA latency benchmark. Looping @matt_cs and @priya_csops.
matt_cs: Got it. I'll lead onboarding. Do we have the Okta app metadata and a technical contact?
lena_sales: Tech contact is Priya Shah (priya.shah@skyline.energy). Okta metadata: ```okta_issuer: https://skyline.okta.com
okta_cert: https://files.redwood/secure/skyline-okta.pem
app_id: 0oab1234XYZ```
priya_csops: I'll create the onboarding ticket and attach a connector intake form. ETA for initial runbook draft?
casey_support: For on-call/readiness, note that Skyline requested 24/7 premium response during POC. If they go GA we should confirm support tier in the contract. I'm flagging potential renewal risk if SLA costs spike.
devin_eng: On connector: what's the DB tech? We prefer pushing via our ingestion agent but can do a pull connector. Also need schema sample.
lena_sales: They run a legacy Sybase archive service. Jordan (tech contact) will share schema extract later today. POC window: 10 business days from onboarding start.
matt_cs: Action list: 1) VPC peering & network range proposal 10.20.8.0/24 80% chance infra will need /24 sizing) 
2) SAML setup (use Okta metadata) 3) Connector spec + security review 4) Benchmark plan + test harness 5) Compliance/support SLA confirmation. Assigning: miguel_platform -> infra (volunteer?), priya_csops -> connector intake & CS runbook, devin_eng -> connector implementation plan, casey_support -> SLA & compliance.
priya_csops: Ticket CS-4902 opened with checklist + intake form: https://docs.redwood/skyline-cs-4902 (internal). I've asked Jordan for schema and test creds; requested by EOD.
devin_eng: I'll put together a connector approach doc. If it's Sybase, we may need to run the ingestion agent in their VPC (VPN or VPC peering). Est 3-5 dev days for POC adapter.
casey_support: I'll loop in legal for SLA language and check if premium SLA is already in SOW. If not, we need AM approval for cost delta.
ops-bot: CS-4902 assigned to priya_csops. Reminder: add "private-deploy" tag if infra is required.
matt_cs: Can everyone confirm ownership? Also, request that infra posts a proposed test endpoint and expected latency numbers before the POC starts. Need those to share with Skyline.
lena_sales: I've set CRM reminders: 45d renewal checkpoint and 7d pre-GA readiness review. Also included "okta-saml" and "legacy-connector" tags.
\dmatt_cs: (typo: dm) ack
priya_csops: Owners ack: priya_csops, devin_eng, casey_support. Need infra assignee.
devin_eng: I'll start a private repo for the adapter and invite priya. Draft ETA for POC adapter by next Wed.
casey_support: Starting SLA thread with legal; aim to confirm by Mon.
matt_cs: Next sync Fri 11am ET. Deliverables by then: infra proposed network + test endpoint, connector schema + POC plan, agreed SLA note. React with :white_check_mark: when confirmed.
